title: Weekly client status - payment gateway
summary: Payment gateway sandbox integration is complete; production is blocked on client-supplied keys, promised by Friday. Go-live moved from the 10th to the 15th with team agreement. A load test failed at 500 concurrent users and is under investigation. Ownership of PCI compliance sign-off is unresolved and was parked.

decisions.decision: Go-live date moved from the 10th to the 15th

action_items.task: Profile DB queries to fix load test failure at 500 concurrent users
Write regression suite for the payment flow

open_questions.question: Is PCI compliance sign-off required before go-live, and who owns it?

risks.risk: Go-live depends on client-supplied production keys with no fallback plan
